$comment: Project-scoped MCP config. Open this folder in Claude Code (or any client that
reads .mcp.json) and MENTOR is connected — that is the fastest way to use this
product the way a student does, with a real model choosing the tools.
It goes through scripts/start-mcp.mjs rather than straight to
sentinel/dist/index.js on purpose: @nitrostack/core resolves widget HTML from
process.cwd(), so launching the entry point directly from the repo root fails
at startup with an error about a missing HTML file. The launcher chdirs first.
Requires a build: npm run sentinel:build
See WALKTHROUGH.md for what to actually say once it is connected.
